title: High-frequency trading in a limit order book

claims.interpretation: Symmetric exponential arrival approximation gives spread gamma*sigma^2*(T-t)+2/gamma*log(1+gamma/k).

assumptions: Normalized unit horizon; gamma, sigma and k are explicit experiment inputs, not fitted values.
Quotes rounded outward to the declared 0.01 tick; one share per quote, inventory cap 4.
deviations: Implements the approximate formulas (29)-(30), not the nonlinear HJB solution.
Uses next-event deterministic L1 crossing, not the paper Poisson arrival experiment.
Synthetic quotes; no claim to replicate published PnL or calibrated market parameters.
mapping_review: Repository author mapping checked against cited source pages; anchors prove provenance, mathematical tests check implementation; external review remains independent.
